title: 综合：两个非线性电阻并联的工作点与小信号响应
statement: 直流 V_s = 10 V 与小信号源 v_s(t) = 0.1cos(100t) V 串联，经 R_1 = 1 Ω 接到结点 a。a 与地之间并联两个非线性元件。N_1 的特性为 i_1 = v²（v ≥ 0；v < 0 时 i_1 = 0）。D 是开启电压 1 V、导通电阻 1 Ω 的二极管模型。
求直流工作点 V_Q、I_1、I_2。再去掉 R_1，求从 a 看进去的小信号等效电阻。最后求 a 点小信号电压的振幅 V_am 和 N_1 中小信号电流的振幅。

questions.ask: 从 a 看进去（去掉 R_1）的小信号等效电阻 = ?
a 点小信号电压的振幅 V_am = ?
N_1 中小信号电流的振幅 I_1m = ?

hints: 直流：两个元件并联在 a 与地之间，先假设 D 导通，列 a 的 KCL。
小信号：直流源置零，N_1、D 分别换成各自在 Q 点的动态电阻，二者并联。
N_1 的动态电阻 1/(2V_Q)；D 导通段的动态电阻就是导通电阻。
solution: **检查：** 小信号 KCL：0.1/(1 + 0.1687) ≈ 85.6 mA = 71.1 + 14.4 mA ✓；D 的瞬时电压始终 > 1 V，导通状态在整个周期内不变，线性化有效 ✓。

en.title: Two nonlinear resistors in parallel: operating point and small-signal response
statement: A DC source V_s = 10 V in series with a small-signal source v_s(t) = 0.1cos(100t) V feeds node a through R_1 = 1 Ω. Between a and ground there are two nonlinear elements in parallel. N_1 has i_1 = v² (v ≥ 0; i_1 = 0 for v < 0). D is a diode model with a 1 V turn-on voltage and a 1 Ω on-resistance.

Find the DC operating point V_Q, I_1, I_2. Then remove R_1 and find the small-signal resistance seen from a. Finally find the amplitude V_am of the small-signal voltage at a and the amplitude of the small-signal current in N_1.

questions.ask: Small-signal resistance seen from a (with R_1 removed) = ?
Amplitude of the small-signal voltage at a, V_am = ?
Amplitude of the small-signal current in N_1, I_1m = ?
questions.explain: I_1m = V_am/R_d1 ≈ 14.43 mV/0.2029 Ω ≈ 71.1 mA; D carries 14.4 mA, together 85.6 mA = 0.1/1.1687 ✓.

hints: DC: both elements are in parallel between a and ground; assume D conducts and write KCL at a.
Small signal: zero the DC source, replace N_1 and D by their dynamic resistances at Q — they are in parallel.
N_1's dynamic resistance is 1/(2V_Q); on its conducting segment D's dynamic resistance is the on-resistance.
solution: **1. DC operating point.** Assume D on: (10 − v)/1 = v² + (v − 1)/1 → v² + 2v − 11 = 0 → **V_Q = −1 + 2√3 ≈ 2.464 V** > 1 V ✓ (the negative root violates v ≥ 0). **I_1 = V_Q² ≈ 6.072 A, I_2 = V_Q − 1 ≈ 1.464 A**.
**2. Dynamic resistances.** R_d1 = 1/(2V_Q) ≈ 0.2029 Ω, R_d2 = 1 Ω; seen from a, **R_d1 ∥ R_d2 ≈ 0.1687 Ω**.
**3. Small-signal circuit.** v_s → R_1 → 0.1687 Ω: **V_am ≈ 0.1 × 0.1687/1.1687 ≈ 14.43 mV**; **I_1m = V_am/R_d1 ≈ 71.1 mA**, and D carries 14.4 mA.
**Check:** small-signal KCL: 0.1/(1 + 0.1687) ≈ 85.6 mA = 71.1 + 14.4 mA ✓; D's instantaneous voltage stays above 1 V, so it conducts all the time and the linearisation is valid ✓.
